scope: Independent fair n-bit database, static retained state of at most M bits, independent indexed queries; all learned code, addresses and database-dependent state must be included in retention
prediction: For nonnegative charges, exact minimum of cA*expected_acquisition_reads+cM*retained_bits+H*cR*expected_query_reads is min over integer m<=M of (cA+cM)*m+H*cR*(1-sum of largest m query probabilities)
search: Enumerate every set partition of all 2^n databases into at most2^M retained symbols, then find optimal adaptive one-bit read trees for acquisition and each retained-symbol/query fiber; no cache template used in synthesis
controls: all2795 canonical encoders covered for n3 M2
acquisition cost independently verified by exhaustive read-tree oracle
every tied optimal memory size retained
changing query distribution can change selected memory
full retention reduces future reads to zero but costs acquisition
boundary: These are three declared resource coordinates, not hardware total cost. CPU/address/code/index overhead, database correlation, changes to stored data, later state updates and nonuniform database bits need different contracts. Parameter holdout only; no unseen architecture family.
